title: Tee hails Najib as a true statesman | FMT
text: Tee hails Najib as a true statesman | FMT Latest Headlines Newsletter Newsletter Sign In Tee hails Najib as a true statesman PETALING JAYA: Prime Minister Najib Razak showed true statesmanship when he offered Umno’s friendship to PAS, according to Sinar Harian columnist Ridhuan Tee Abdullah. Statesmen build bridges instead of burning them, Tee says as he rubbished Parti Amanah Negara’s claim that Najib made the offer out of desperation to maintain his position. “If they keep burning bridges, this beloved nation will be destroyed,” he writes in his latest article. The controversial preacher also says cooperation between the two parties should have happened a long time ago if they had understood the political realities of Malaysia, with the Muslim and non-Muslim populations split almost equally. “That is, unless they want to be governed by the ultra kiasu,” he sneers, using his term for opposition politicians or those perceived to be enemies of Islam. Tee urges Umno to stop attacking PAS unless the latter strays from the Islamic path. In the coming general election, he says, Umno should not contest in areas dominated by PAS. He suggests that the campaign funds thus saved be used for helping those in need, such as building houses for flood victims. Umno should concentrate its campaign on winning Selangor and Penang, he adds. During the recent Umno general assembly, Najib expressed his happiness over PAS’ split from the opposition pact. He said a tie-up between Umno and PAS would go a long way towards ensuring that Malaysia was developed along Islamic lines.
